capabilities: capture X bookmark and history posts with a browser companion
import captured posts as linked Markdown notes
group notes into tweets, authors, topics, and domains
explore bookmarks in an interactive graph
disambiguation: The bookmarks here are posts saved on the X social network, not Obsidian's own Bookmarks core feature.
extras: Desktop only; during public beta it must be installed manually from a GitHub release rather than the community directory; capture only saves posts you actually scroll past, and deleted X bookmarks are not removed from the vault.
problem: X bookmarks are locked to the platform's own page, so saving and connecting them as notes requires manual copying or the paid X API.
summary: Imports your X (Twitter) bookmarks via a browser companion into linked Markdown notes and explores them in an interactive graph.
